title: Jugendliche bei Verkehrsunfall mit E-Scooter verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: A 14-year-old e-scooter rider left the cycle path and hit a traffic light pole at the Roedernallee/Lindauer Allee junction, injuring her; a 13-year-old passenger was unhurt. Police also found an insurance violation involving the scooter.
